skill_name: Invent a new recipe using bananas
workflow: Why not try Banana Cream Pie Chocolate Chip Muffins? Preheat the oven to 350 degrees. In a large bowl, mix together the dry ingredients: 1 cup all-purpose flour, 1 teaspoon baking powder, 1/2 teaspoon baking soda, and 1/2 teaspoon salt. In another bowl, cream together 1/2 cup butter and 1/2 cup granulated sugar. Add 2 eggs and 1 teaspoon vanilla extract, and mix until well combined. Mash two ripe bananas, and add them to the mixture, along with 1/2 cup chopped walnuts and 1/2 cup semi-sweet choc
